title: parse.rs build_part: no_content_type flag extracted separately from content_type()
description: parse.rs build_part: 'let no_content_type = part.content_type().is_none()' then part.content_type() is called again two more times. Suggested rewrite: capture part.content_type() once into a local 'let ct_opt = part.content_type()' and use ct_opt throughout. This reduces three API calls to one and makes the no_content_type derivation explicit.
